title: Signal: Child process executed with a shell-free API but unvalidated program path in zig — review required
scope: Single-line match on a child process launch in zig.
limitations: Lexical: matches Child initialisation; whether the executable path is constant is a review question.

examples.line: # audit: var child = std.process.Child.init(argv, allocator); present

fpNotes: A fixed absolute path with constant arguments is the accepted false positive.
